{{Top|leg}}
The '''Velx-Shel raid''' was a criminal undertaking perpetrated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velx-Shel]]. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Arkle Tellaro]] took part in the raid, which netted a lot of money, and went into hiding on a tropical island after [[Corellian Security Forces|CorSec]] begun the hunt for the criminals.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
